title: Scripture
about: The Bible from the ancient source languages to today, in every language eBible.org is allowed to share. Seed is a curated line from Hebrew, Greek, Latin and Coptic through the landmark English translations to major world languages. Ark adds every public domain translation. Eden adds every translation eBible.org may redistribute.

items.note: More than a thousand languages. Each translation keeps its own copyright notice inside the download.

items.title: Theographic Bible Metadata: the people, places and events of the Bible, linked verse by verse
items.note: More than 3,000 people, about 1,300 places (nearly all with map coordinates) and a timeline of events, each tied to the King James verses that mention it, plus Easton's Bible Dictionary. JSON, CSV and GeoJSON for builders and researchers, by Robert Rouse of Viz.Bible. Its dates follow Floyd Nolen Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament.
Commentary and answers from one ministry, not scripture.
